test.create_query: CREATE TABLE insert_merge_src ( n UInt64, id_uh UInt64, id_hh UInt64, ver_h UInt32, sign_h Int8, ts DateTime, user_id UInt64, url String, title String, status LowCardinality(String), amount Float64, qty UInt32, ip IPv4 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY n

CREATE TABLE insert_merge_r (id UInt64, ver UInt32, ts DateTime, user_id UInt64, url String, title String, status LowCardinality(String), amount Float64, qty UInt32, ip IPv4) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(ver) ORDER BY id

CREATE TABLE insert_merge_c (id UInt64, sign Int8, ts DateTime, user_id UInt64, url String, title String, status LowCardinality(String), amount Float64, qty UInt32, ip IPv4) ENGINE = CollapsingMergeTree(sign) ORDER BY id

CREATE TABLE insert_merge_v (id UInt64, sign Int8, ver UInt32, ts DateTime, user_id UInt64, url String, title String, status LowCardinality(String), amount Float64, qty UInt32, ip IPv4) ENGINE = VersionedCollapsingMergeTree(sign, ver) ORDER BY id

CREATE TABLE insert_merge_nv (id UInt64, ts DateTime, user_id UInt64, url String, title String, status LowCardinality(String), amount Float64, qty UInt32, ip IPv4) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE insert_merge_n0 (id UInt64, ver UInt32) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(ver) ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO insert_merge_src SELECT number AS n, cityHash64(n), cityHash64(intDiv(n, 3)), toUInt32(if(n % 3 = 2, 2, 1)), toInt8(if(n % 3 = 1, -1, 1)), toDateTime(1700000000 + intDiv(n, 10)), intHash64(n) % 1000000, concat('https://example.com/', toString(intHash32(n) % 100000), '/page?id=', toString(n % 9973)), concat('Product title ', toString(intHash32(n * 7) % 50000)), ['new', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled', 'returned'][n % 5 + 1], (intHash32(n) % 100000) / 100., toUInt32(n % 50), CAST(toUInt32(intHash32(n)) AS IPv4) FROM numbers(1000000)
